_comment: Provenance for rust/src/assets/model.bin: the model @ternlight/base@0.1.1 ships, recovered by scripts/extract-model-from-wasm.mjs from the WASM's LINEAR MEMORY. Supersedes the HuggingFace model-int4.bin, which is a different (d256) model with the same 384-dim output width.
_hash_note: sha256/bytes describe model.bin as written, which is the 7,492,280-byte body followed by its own 32-byte SHA-256. body_sha256/body_bytes describe the body alone — the checksum rust/src/engine/format.rs::verify_sha256 recomputes when the engine loads it, so a body_sha256 match means the engine will accept the file.
_correction: The sha256 and bytes recorded here previously described an extraction that extract-model-from-wasm.mjs's own notes call WRONG: the file-shaped slice, which splices 11 bytes of WASM data-segment scaffolding into the weights. That file still loaded and still returned unit-length vectors, so nothing caught it, and for a while these fields matched a file that no longer existed. Corrected to the values the current model.bin actually has.
